observations: Local documentation search is a strict all-words match with no stop-word handling. A reader query containing a function word the article does not use, such as "which version", returns no match while "version information" and "report a defect" both reach the guide. That is search behavior shared by every article, not a gap in this batch, and Help still lists the guide by title.
limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Articles are read from the working documentation preview at 43333 over the immutable 43332 backend, so the reader shows the intentional development-preview and Unverified article notices.
